raw_site_text: six of the largest universities ... Maputo campuses; ... Beira campuses
justification: Baseline surveys were at universities with Maputo campuses (UEM, UP, AP, USTM) and Beira campuses (UCM, UZ); Beira is in Sofala.
note: Maputo (city/province) is not in admissible_units so is not matched; later rounds were by phone and graduates may have been located anywhere. Patched 2026-10-20 after supplementary WB units were added: Maputo campuses -> 'Cidade de Maputo' (WB GAUL2).
